topic: Dizilerden: ileri phrasal verb ve collocation'lar

items.example: Don't sneak up on me like that!
items.simple: You walk very quietly so someone does not hear you.
dialogue: A: You scared me!
B: Sorry, I didn't mean to sneak up on you.
A: My heart is racing.
items.note: Friends ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da korkutma şakaları.

items.tr: kendine gelmek, kötü ruh halinden çıkmak
items.example: Snap out of it! She's not worth it.
items.simple: You stop feeling sad or silly and think clearly again.
dialogue: A: I'll be sad forever.
B: Snap out of it. Let's get pizza.
A: Okay, with extra cheese.
items.note: Friends'te dertli arkadaşa söylenen klasik cümle.

items.example: Don't wimp out on me now.
items.exampleTr: Şimdi korkup beni yarı yolda bırakma.
items.simple: You are too scared to do something, so you stop.
dialogue: A: Are you coming on the ride?
B: I think I'll wimp out.
A: Come on! It's only a small drop.
items.note: Big Bang Theory'de korkak karakter Howard/Raj.

items.example: Why don't you stick around for dinner?
items.simple: You stay in a place a little longer.
dialogue: A: Do you have to go?
B: I can stick around for a bit.
A: Cool, the movie starts soon.
items.note: Friends'te misafir/arkadaş sahnelerinde.

items.example: He pulled a fast one on us.
items.simple: You trick someone, and they do not see it coming.
dialogue: A: This price is wrong.
B: I think the seller tried to pull a fast one.
A: Let's check again.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da kandırma konularında.

items.example: He got caught red-handed with the cookies.
items.simple: Someone sees you right when you do something wrong.
dialogue: A: Did Reese get caught red-handed?
B: Yes, with chocolate on his face.
A: Classic.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve Seinfeld'te yakalanma sahneleri.

items.example: Let's play hooky and go to the beach.
items.simple: You do not go to school or work, and you do not tell anyone.
dialogue: A: Want to play hooky today?
B: And lie to the boss?
A: Just say you're sick.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve Modern Family'de.

items.example: Someone was nosing around my desk.
items.simple: You look at private things that are not yours.
dialogue: A: Why were you in my room?
B: I like to nose around, sorry.
A: Stop it.
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da merak.

items.example: We pigged out on pizza last night.
items.simple: You eat a very large amount of food.
dialogue: A: Let's pig out at the buffet.
B: I skipped lunch for this.
A: Me too.
items.note: Friends'te Joey ve yemek sahnelerinde.

items.example: Pipe down! I'm on the phone.
items.simple: You tell people to be quiet.
dialogue: A: Pipe down, you two!
B: He started it!
A: I don't care.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da ebeveynlerin sık cümlesi.

items.example: Don't let him psych you out.
items.simple: You make a person scared so they play badly.
dialogue: A: He's trying to psych out the team.
B: Ignore him.
A: Easy for you to say.
items.note: Spor ve rekabet sahnelerinde.

items.example: That restaurant totally ripped us off.
items.simple: Someone sells you something for too much money.
dialogue: A: Twenty dollars for a sandwich?
B: They rip off every tourist.
A: Let's find another place.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Modern Family'de fiyat şikâyetleri.

items.example: He ran out on his family.
items.simple: You leave a person when they need you.
dialogue: A: Did he run out on you?
B: Yes, with my car.
A: I'm so sorry.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Modern Family'de ağır sahneler.

items.example: Let's scope out the bar before we go in.
items.exampleTr: İçeri girmeden önce barı bir kolaçan edelim.
items.simple: You look carefully at a place before you do something.
dialogue: A: Let's scope out the party first.
B: Who's there?
A: Just the usual people.
items.note: HIMYM ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da.

items.example: I really screwed up this time.
items.simple: You make a big mistake.
dialogue: A: I think I screw up everything.
B: Not everything.
A: Name one thing.
items.note: Her dizide en çok duyulan fiillerden; samimi dil.

items.example: She shot down every idea I had.
items.simple: You say no to someone's idea very fast.
dialogue: A: They shoot down all my ideas.
B: Bring a better one.
A: You're not helping.
items.note: Toplantı ve ofis sahnelerinde.

items.example: One slip up and the secret is out.
items.exampleTr: Tek bir hata ve sır ortaya çıkar.
items.simple: You make a small mistake by accident.
dialogue: A: Don't slip up tonight.
B: I'll be careful.
A: One mistake and we're done.
items.note: Breaking Bad'de küçük hata büyük sonuç.

items.example: I caught him snooping around my room.
items.simple: You look for private things when nobody is watching.
dialogue: A: Why do you snoop around here?
B: I lost my keys.
A: Check your pocket.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve Seinfeld'te.

items.example: She stormed out of the meeting.
items.simple: You leave a room angrily and fast.
dialogue: A: Why did she storm out?
B: Nobody listened to her.
A: Let's go talk to her.
items.note: The Office ve Friends'te dramatik çıkışlar.

items.example: I'll swing by your place later.
items.simple: You visit a place quickly on your way somewhere.
dialogue: A: Can you swing by the store?
B: Sure. What do you need?
A: Milk and eggs.
items.note: Friends ve The Office'te günlük konuşma.

items.example: I tuned out after the first ten minutes.
items.exampleTr: İlk on dakikadan sonra dinlemeyi bıraktım.
items.simple: You stop listening, even if someone is talking.
dialogue: A: You tune out when I talk.
B: That's not true.
A: What did I just say?
items.note: Big Bang Theory'de uzun lafların sonu.

items.example: You need to wise up before it's too late.
items.exampleTr: Çok geç olmadan aklını başına almalısın.
items.simple: You start to see things more clearly and stop being silly.
dialogue: A: She'll never change.
B: You need to wise up.
A: I know. I know.
items.note: Dizilerde tavsiye cümlesi.

items.example: Let's wrap up this meeting quickly.
items.simple: You finish something that is almost done.
dialogue: A: Can we wrap up by five?
B: If you stop talking.
A: Ha ha. Very funny.
items.note: The Office'te toplantı bitişi.

items.example: We stayed up all night talking.
items.simple: You do not go to bed, and you are awake late.
dialogue: A: Don't stay up too late.
B: Just one more episode.
A: You always say that.
items.note: Friends'te gece sohbetleri.

items.example: I had to sit through a three-hour speech.
items.exampleTr: Üç saatlik bir konuşmayı sonuna kadar dinlemek zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: You stay until the end, even if it is boring.
dialogue: A: Can't believe we have to sit through this.
B: At least there's free food.
A: True.
items.note: Big Bang Theory ve The Office'te.

items.example: We should spice up our date nights.
items.simple: You make something more fun or more exciting.
dialogue: A: Let's spice up the party.
B: With a karaoke machine?
A: Yes!
items.note: HIMYM ve Modern Family'de.
